title: “I Would Never Trust Anything Western”: Kumu (Educator) Perspectives on Use of LLMs for Culturally Revitalizing CS Education in Hawaiian Schools

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative thematic analysis and quantitative survey evaluation of educators' perspectives on AI-generated content, specifically assessing Western epistemological defaults, stereotyping, and cultural misrepresentation of Hawaiian history and Indigenous knowledge.

Surveys and semi-structured interviews with educators to evaluate LLMs' translation accuracy, linguistic capability, and contextual understanding when generating content in 'Olelo Hawai'i (the Hawaiian language), a low-resource language.
